bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
repo=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
cd "$repo"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 70
test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = sha256:58ae5730a1b9622acc5d34f635318dd39f0c45563b65ab59ee6b9f842f64cab1 || exit 71
tmp="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
cp scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py "$tmp/original.py"
python3 - "$tmp/original.py" "$tmp/updated.py" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import ast,sys
s=Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text()
old='''                                if any(type(b).__name__ != "KeyboardButtonCopy" for b in raw):
                                    raise RuntimeError("INVITE_COPY_BUTTON_TYPE_MISMATCH")
                                texts = [str(getattr(b, "copy_text", "")) for b in raw]'''
new='''                                # Verify real copy payload; class names vary by SDK version.
                                texts = [str(getattr(b, "copy_text", "")) for b in raw]
                                if any(not text.startswith("https://t.me/GayBBS_bot?start=gate_") for text in texts):
                                    raise RuntimeError("INVITE_COPY_BUTTON_TYPE_MISMATCH")'''
assert s.count(old)==1
updated=s.replace(old,new)
ast.parse(updated)
Path(sys.argv[2]).write_text(updated)
PY
cp "$tmp/updated.py" scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py
chmod 600 scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py
systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service
sleep 3
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 72
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled || exit 73
if ! timeout 40s python3 scripts/userbot_test_client.py health >/dev/null 2>&1;then exit 74;fi
result="$(timeout 70s python3 scripts/userbot_test_client.py invite_selector_smoke 2>&1 || true)"
chat="$(timeout 70s python3 scripts/userbot_test_client.py chat_selector_smoke 2>&1 || true)"
{
 echo "INVITE_COPY_ACTUAL_PAYLOAD_TEST"
 printf '%s\n' "$result" | grep '^USERBOT_TEST_' | head -5 || true
 echo "CHAT_RESULT=$(printf '%s' "$chat" | grep '^USERBOT_TEST_RESULT=' | head -1 || echo UNKNOWN)"
 echo "USERBOT_ACTIVE=$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)"
 echo "USERBOT_ENABLED=$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)"
} | gh issue comment 7 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body-file - >/dev/null
